items.quote: “Equity and Human Rights” or “EQHR” is the unit at the University with institutional accountability for receiving and responding to Consultations, requests for Voluntary Process, and Reports, including conducting and overseeing investigations.
items.reason: The policy is a stand-alone policy with its own reporting and investigation processes overseen by EQHR.

items.quote: The University will create and maintain a Sexualized Violence website that provides information about the Policy as well as support and response options and an up-to-date list of Sexualized Violence Education opportunities.
items.reason: The policy mentions providing information about the policy on a website but does not explicitly commit to posting the full policy text publicly.

items.quote: Filling a Report means completing a Report form and filing it with EQHR with the intention of having the University initiate an investigation of an incident(s) of Sexualized Violence.
items.reason: The policy outlines clear steps for reporting, including completing a report form and filing it with EQHR after a consultation.
The policy does not address whether a complainant's past sexual history can be raised or considered during the process.

items.quote: The Complainant and Respondent will not be required to meet as part of the investigation.
items.reason: The policy explicitly guarantees that the complainant and respondent will not be required to meet during the investigation.

items.quote: University Community Members who are participating in a Voluntary Process, investigation, or review are free to speak about their own experiences but must not disclose information that they learn solely as a result of their participation in Policy processes, because this Personal Information belongs to another individual.
items.reason: The policy explicitly states that participants are free to speak about their own experiences.

items.quote: A process under the Policy or its associated procedures may occur simultaneously with, prior to, or following any human rights, criminal, civil, or other proceeding.
items.reason: The policy mentions that institutional and external processes can occur concurrently, but does not explicitly frame this as the survivor's absolute choice.

items.quote: Hence, the University will not subject any individual who makes a Disclosure or Report or witnesses Sexualized Violence to disciplinary action for their personal use of alcohol or substance use occurring at or near the time of the incident(s).
items.reason: The policy provides explicit and binding amnesty from disciplinary action for drug or alcohol use at the time of the incident.

items.quote: The Director will specify an expected timeline for the investigator to complete the investigation and submit the investigation report.
items.reason: The policy does not set a specific, binding overall timeline for the complaint process, leaving it to the discretion of the Director.

items.quote: The University may apply Interim Measures where the University believes it must act to protect a University Community Member’s health or safety or University property.
items.reason: The application of interim measures is discretionary, as indicated by the use of the word 'may'.
The policy's scope explicitly includes co-op and practicum placements.

items.quote: The Complainant will be informed of any restrictions that the University imposes on the Respondent if those restrictions directly affect the Complainant’s health and/or safety.
items.reason: Informing the complainant of the outcome is limited, as they are not entitled to know about disciplinary actions unless they directly affect their safety.

items.quote: This report will be publicly available online and will contain: (a) available statistics on Disclosures and Reports to EQHR (including available demographic details);
items.reason: The policy commits to publishing an annual report online containing statistics on disclosures and reports.

items.quote: In any event, the University will review the Policy at least once every three years, and when directed to do so by the provincial government.
items.reason: The policy requires a review at least once every three years, which is longer than the two-year benchmark.

items.quote: This should include consultation with Students, staff, faculty, and librarians.
items.reason: Student consultation is required during the policy review, but there is no mandate for a specific 30% student representation on the committee.

items.quote: General Counsel Office will compile and maintain a roster of investigators who: (a) are trained in Trauma-Informed investigation practices;
items.reason: The policy mentions trauma-informed training for investigators on a roster, but does not strictly mandate that all investigators or decision-makers must have this training.

items.quote: Office of Student Life, in conjunction with EQHR, will design and implement student-focused Sexualized Violence education and training in alignment with the Policy and associated Procedures.
items.reason: The policy commits to designing and implementing student-focused sexualized violence education and training.
